notes: Orders Expected → gentle reminder emails to buyers. Two new email templates (Master → Email templates): 'Order expected — gentle reminder (late)' and 'Order expected — reminder before the date'. Reports → Expected Orders: a '✉ Remind' button on every buyer (choose late or coming-soon, edit and send) and a badge when a reminder was sent. Automatic: in each of the two templates switch on 'Send this reminder by itself' and set the days — late: N days after the expected date (default 7); coming: N days before (default 5). Sent once for each expected date, 10 am–7 pm, from the buyer's firm email; not to buyers with an order in the Orders Book, buyers who stopped buying, or buyers without email.
